_comment: Pièces séparées du shop, décrites pour SpriteCook (édition du corps de base : seule la pièce change). Chaque pièce est générée sur les 5 gabarits de outfits.json.

slots.top: Only change the shirt: now wearing {d}. Keep exactly the same brown trousers, same brown belt and same brown boots.
slots.legs: Only change the trousers: now wearing {d}. Keep exactly the same beige shirt, same brown belt and same brown boots.
slots.feet: Only change the boots: now wearing {d}. Keep exactly the same beige shirt, same brown trousers and same brown belt.
slots.hands: Only add gloves: now wearing {d} on both hands. Keep exactly the same beige shirt with rolled sleeves, same brown trousers, same belt and same boots.

tail: Bare head and face unchanged, no helmet, no hood, no weapon, empty hands.

forest_jerkin: a short sleeved dark green leather jerkin with brass buckles over the torso, bare forearms
padded_gambeson: a quilted crimson padded gambeson with long sleeves and a high collar
chain_shirt: a long sleeved steel chainmail shirt reaching the hips
noble_doublet: an elegant royal blue doublet embroidered with gold patterns, long sleeves with white cuffs
fur_vest: a sleeveless brown fur vest with leather lacing, bare muscular arms
iron_greaves: dark grey plated leg armor with steel knee guards
black_breeches: black leather trousers with silver studs along the sides
ranger_trousers: dark navy blue cloth trousers, entirely navy blue from the belt to the boots, with black leather knee pads
royal_breeches: white breeches with a gold stripe down each leg
fur_boots: tall grey fur-lined boots tied with leather cords
elven_boots: tall pointed dark green elven boots with silver leaf buckles
riding_boots: tall black leather riding boots with silver buckles
leather_gloves: dark brown leather gloves with short cuffs
fingerless_gloves: black fingerless leather gloves with bare fingers
fur_bracers: brown leather gloves with grey fur bracers on the forearms
